hebrewText: שְֽׁמַֽע נָ֞א יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּד֗וֹל אַתָּה֙ וְ/רֵעֶ֨י/ךָ֙ הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֣ים לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ כִּֽי אַנְשֵׁ֥י מוֹפֵ֖ת הֵ֑מָּה כִּֽי הִנְ/נִ֥י מֵבִ֛יא אֶת עַבְדִּ֖/י צֶֽמַח

tokens.bdb: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] attentively, call (gather) together, [idiom] carefully, [idiom] certainly, consent, consider, be content, declare, [idiom] diligently, discern, give ear, (cause to, let, make to) hear(-ken, tell), [idiom] indeed, listen, make (a) noise, (be) obedient, obey, perceive, (make a) proclaim(-ation), publish, regard, report, shew (forth), (make a) sound, [idiom] surely, tell, understand, whosoever (heareth), witness.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention
tokens.enLiteralWord: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention
tokens.explanation: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention
tokens.explanationEn: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention

tokens.bdb: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
tokens.kjv: I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.
Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare H1954 (הוֹשֵׁעַ), H3442 (יֵשׁוּעַ).

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, elder(-est), [phrase] exceeding(-ly), [phrase] far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, [idiom] sore, ([idiom]) very.

tokens.bdb: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you

tokens.kjv: brother, companion, fellow, friend, husband, lover, neighbour, [idiom] (an-) other.

tokens.bdb: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
tokens.kjv: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.

tokens.bdb: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] accept, a-(be-) fore(-time), against, anger, [idiom] as (long as), at, [phrase] battle, [phrase] because (of), [phrase] beseech, countenance, edge, [phrase] employ, endure, [phrase] enquire, face, favour, fear of, for, forefront(-part), form(-er time, -ward), from, front, heaviness, [idiom] him(-self), [phrase] honourable, [phrase] impudent, [phrase] in, it, look(-eth) (-s), [idiom] me, [phrase] meet, [idiom] more than, mouth, of, off, (of) old (time), [idiom] on, open, [phrase] out of, over against, the partial, person, [phrase] please, presence, propect, was purposed, by reason of, [phrase] regard, right forth, [phrase] serve, [idiom] shewbread, sight, state, straight, [phrase] street, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them(-selves), through ([phrase] -out), till, time(-s) past, (un-) to(-ward), [phrase] upon, upside ([phrase] down), with(-in, [phrase] -stand), [idiom] ye, [idiom] you.

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
a sprout (usually concrete), literal or figurative
tokens.kjv: branch, bud, that which (where) grew (upon), spring(-ing).
